title: nn_l1_sbi: wavelet l1 versus neural compression for tomographic weak-lensing SBI

creators.name: Tersenov, Andreas
creators.affiliation: Department of Physics, University of Crete, Greece; Institutes of Computer Science and Astrophysics, Foundation for Research and Technology Hellas (FORTH), Greece; Universite Paris-Saclay, Universite Paris Cite, CEA, CNRS, AIM, Gif-sur-Yvette, France

description:
Companion code for a weak-lensing simulation-based-inference study that compares wavelet (starlet) l1-norm summary statistics against learned convolutional compressors on tomographic convergence maps. The repository contains the summary statistics and compression code, the inference and calibration drivers, the figure generators, the SLURM campaign that produced the published numbers, and a reproduction notebook.

The Table 1 inputs (12 arms, figures of merit and their error bars) are committed in the repository under data/table1/, so that table reproduces with no download. The larger figure and analysis inputs are distributed as a separate Zenodo data record; see data/ZENODO_MANIFEST.md.

Third-party attribution is in NOTICE. This repository vendors no third-party source code; it redistributes one small patch file that is a derivative of sbi_lens (MIT).
